family.principle: One company system. Four independent products. One recognizable product family.

endorsement.note: Relationship rule. Product surfaces must make OpsDevCode ownership discoverable while keeping independent product identity. Literal UI string is not required on every page.

maturity_vocabulary.early-access: Product capabilities exist and are marketed. Hosted access is waitlist or invite, not general self-serve.
maturity_vocabulary.in-development: Product identity and some implementation exist. Not generally available. Public identity may still be thin.
maturity_vocabulary.emerging: Boundary and name are defined. Runtime and public identity are early; may still be intertwined with another product's hosted surface.

authority.portfolio: Repave ADR 020 (OpsDevCode product architecture). Authoritative for company vs products vs Convergence.
does_not_override: Repave ADR 009 remains the historical record of Repave display name and mark. It does not define the company or parent-platform hierarchy.
ADR 009 phrases such as "intelligent platform layer" must not override this contract.

convergence.name: Convergence
convergence.note: OpsDevCode may follow, reference, support, or apply Convergence. Convergence is not an OpsDevCode product, not in the four-product portfolio, not a runtime, and not a fifth product surface.

relay.name: Relay
relay.note: Conversational runtime consumed by Dispatch. Not a public OpsDevCode product. GitHub governance may still use the product profile for this private repo.

aliases.note: Existing Repave alias. Does not redefine ownership or portfolio structure.

invariants: Every product must be independently understandable.
A visitor should not need to understand Repave before understanding Overpass, Toll, or Dispatch.
Each product owns its own proposition and product-specific experience.
Every product must remain recognizably part of OpsDevCode.
Shared family identity must not make the products visually identical.
Repave is not the shell or container for sibling public identities.
Sibling product Host headers must be routed to that product's identity workload, not interpreted by Repave CanonicalHostMiddleware.

runtime_boundary.canonical_host_middleware_scope: Repave owns Repave canonical-host behavior only.
runtime_boundary.sibling_identity: Must not depend on reaching the Repave origin and being rewritten to it.
